title: icu_locale_core 2.4.0 (Unicode-3.0) contains LicenseRef-scancode-proprietary-license in 1 place(s): source

decision.rationale: REASON-002: False positive; lines 3-5 are the ICU4X header link to its LICENSE and the doc text 'intended for private use' (BCP 47 private-use '-x-' subtags), not a licence. Crate LICENSE is Unicode-3.0, allowed by Lattice's policy and already in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.
